title: Who is referee for England vs Norway? Three Lions handed reunion and potential good omen | talkSPORT
text:
The refereeing team for the last eight clash in Miami has been confirmed by FIFA.

It comes ahead of the Norway vs England game on Saturday, with kick-off at 10pm (BST) live on talkSPORT.

The winner will face either Argentina or Switzerland on Wednesday for a place in the final.

France's Clement Turpin has been announced as the man in the middle at the Hard Rock Stadium this weekend.

It will be the 44-year-old's fourth match at this summer's World Cup and his ninth overall.

Turpin previously officiated at both the 2018 and 2022 tournaments.

He will be assisted by compatriots Nicolas Danos and Benjamin Pages in Florida.

Meanwhile, Alejandro Hernandez and Jose Enrique Naranjo of Spain will serve as fourth official and reserve assistant referee, respectively.

Turpin has already overseen three matches in North America, including England's opening victory over Croatia on June 17.

He has since taken charge of the goalless draw between Paraguay and Australia as well as Colombia's last 32 win against Ghana.

Despite not issuing a single booking during the Three Lions' match with Croatia, Turpin has since handed out seven yellow cards in two matches.

Referee: Clement Turpin (France)

Video Assistant Referee: Jerome Brisard

Assistant Referee 1: Nicolas Danos

Assistant Referee 2: Benjamin Pages

Fourth Official: Alejandro Jose Hernandez Hernandez

Assistant VAR Official: Armando Villarreal

That could provide a cause for concern for England, with four players walking a tightrope before their yellow cards are reset after the last eight.

Jude Bellingham, Declan Rice, Marc Guehi and Nico O'Reilly would all be suspended for a potential semi-final if they are booked against Norway.

However, both Rice and Guehi are fitness doubts for the match due to a sickness bug and hamstring strain, respectively.

Turpin has refereed England more than any other national team during his career.

Their match against Norway will mark the ninth time the Frenchman has officiated the Three Lions.

They have won five of those previous eight matches, with the only draw a goalless stalemate against Slovenia at Euro 2024.

England matches with Clement Turpin as referee

September 2017 - England 2-1 Slovakia, 2018 World Cup qualifier

September 2018 - England 1-0 Switzerland, Friendly

June 2019 - Netherlands 3-1 England (AET), Nations League semi-final

June 2022 - England 0-4 Hungary, Nations League

October 2023 - England 3-1 Italy, Euro 2024 qualifier

June 2024 - England 0-0 Slovenia, Euro 2024

September 2025 - Serbia 0-5 England, 2026 World Cup qualifier

June 2026 - England 4-2 Croatia, 2026 World Cup

Ahead of Saturday's encounter, England are unbeaten in four matches with Turpin in the middle.

Their last defeat came against Hungary in the Nations League, with Gareth Southgate's side suffering a 4-0 loss in June 2022.

Turpin also previously oversaw the extra-time reverse against the Netherlands in the 2019 Nations League semi-finals.

In contrast, he has refereed just one match involving Norway to date, which ended in a 2-0 defeat to the Netherlands in qualifying for the 2022 World Cup.
